resources.string: Prompt skill guide
Help for prompt skills
Skills transform prompts using your configured AI endpoint. Usage tags describe intended scenarios; they do not automatically trigger generation, upload media or bypass paid confirmation.
Usage scopes
Input sources
Execution mode
Output mode
Workflow matching

Comma-separated workflow name/path keywords limit where a skill appears; empty means all workflows. Matching is case-insensitive. For example: minimax, h3. The most suitable skill is recommended first, but you can pick another.
How to use

1. Configure your AI endpoint. 2. Open a workflow\'s prompt field and tap a skill. 3. Review the response and choose replace or append. Edit any scope/input/execution/output tag only when the receiving workflow supports it.
